changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE account ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, owner_name NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_account_balance DEFAULT (0), status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_account_status DEFAULT ('ACTIVE'), created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_account_created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), updated_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_account_updated DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), CONSTRAINT PK_account PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT UQ_account_number UNIQUE (account_number), CONSTRAINT CK_account_balance CHECK (balance >= 0), CONSTRAINT CK_account_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','FROZEN','CLOSED')) );

changeSet.author: you
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE transfer ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, from_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, to_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL, currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, failure_reason NVARCHAR(255) NULL, created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_transfer_created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), CONSTRAINT PK_transfer PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT UQ_transfer_idem UNIQUE (idempotency_key), CONSTRAINT FK_transfer_from FOREIGN KEY (from_account_id) REFERENCES account(id), CONSTRAINT FK_transfer_to FOREIGN KEY (to_account_id) REFERENCES account(id), CONSTRAINT CK_transfer_amount CHECK (amount > 0), CONSTRAINT CK_transfer_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','COMPLETED','FAILED')) );

changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_entry ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, transfer_id BIGINT NULL, entry_type VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL, balance_after DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ledger_created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), CONSTRAINT PK_ledger PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT FK_ledger_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id), CONSTRAINT FK_ledger_transfer FOREIGN KEY (transfer_id) REFERENCES transfer(id), CONSTRAINT CK_ledger_type CHECK (entry_type IN ('DEBIT','CREDIT')), CONSTRAINT CK_ledger_amount CHECK (amount > 0) );
CREATE INDEX IX_ledger_account ON ledger_entry (account_id, created_at DESC);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox_event ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, aggregate_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, aggregate_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, payload NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_outbox_status DEFAULT ('PENDING'), created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_outbox_created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), published_at DATETIME2(3) NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_outbox PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT CK_outbox_st CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','PUBLISHED','FAILED')) );
